source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Unergative verbal roots and unergative verbs as √-suffix combinations
notes: The accusative direct object can itself be suffixed with the diminutive suffix. In this case the verbal diminutive can no longer modify the object: the only option left for it is event modification.
en: Misha ran around a small field in short bouts.
